verdict.rationale: Probes confirm docs.nvidia.com serves a working llms.txt index (HTTP 200) plus markdown-rendered versions of product docs pages (e.g. the DGX B200 user guide .md variant), directly enabling agent-oriented consumption of NVIDIA's technical docs. Missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation of agents actually using this llms.txt in practice, and no OpenAPI/machine-readable API spec (404s) to complement it.
